summary: I don't trust Scott Pruitt, whole fox in the hen house, but can someone in #openscience explain why only accepting studies with publicly available data is a bad thing? Isn't that our goal open research and open data? Can't health data be anonymized and still shared openly?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I don't trust Scott Pruitt, whole fox in the hen house, but can someone in #openscience explain why only accepting studies with publicly available data is a bad thing? Isn't that our goal open research and open data? Can't health data be anonymized and still shared openly?
